title: ophrys lutea subsp. corsica
intro: Ophrys lutea subsp. corsica, commonly known as the Corsican Bee Orchid, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Orchidaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems and digestive disorders, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Ophrys lutea subsp. corsica include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, making it a potential treatment for wounds, infections, and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
